# Research Guides at Harvard Library

> A comprehensive research guide portal providing subject-specific resources, archival collections, and course-integrated guides across Harvard's libraries and schools.

Research Guides at Harvard Library serves as the central discovery hub for Harvard's academic community, offering curated guides to library resources, archival materials, and research tools across disciplines. The guides are organized by subject area, course, and special collections, with particular strength in humanities, medical sciences, and institutional archives.

## Key Topics

- Harvard Library
- Harvard University Archives
- Research guides
- Subject guides
- Course guides
- Library resources
- Archival collections
- Countway Library

- Cold War oral histories

## Core Research Portals

- [Home - Research Guides at Harvard Library](https://guides.library.harvard.edu): Harvard Library research guides portal and main discovery hub
- [Home - Literary Research in Harvard Libraries](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/literature): Literary research guide covering comparative and English literature

## Subject & Discipline Guides

- [Home - East Asian Art](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/EastAsianArt): Research guide to East Asian art history resources and materials
- [Quick Links - Countway Library Resources](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/countwayresearch): Quick links to Countway Library research databases and discovery tools
- [Finding Evidence - EBM Resources - Evidence-based Medicine and Dentistry](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/hms/ebm): Evidence-based medicine and dentistry resources from Countway Library
- [Finding Funding - Grants & Grant Makers](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/hks/grants): HKS guide to finding grants and identifying grant makers
- [The Basics: How Do I...? - Education Leadership, Organizations, and Entrepreneurship](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/ELOE): Basics guide for Education Leadership research at Harvard GSE

## Course Guides & Writing Support

- [Expo E-42a Library Research Guide - Expo S-42A | Writing in the Humanities: The Gothic](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/42a): Course guide for Expository Writing: The Gothic literature research
- [Thinking with Conspiracies - Expos 20 | Thinking with Conspiracies](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/conspiracy): Course guide for Expos 20 on conspiracy theories and critical thinking
- [Welcome and About This Guide - Expos 20: The Life Well-Lived](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/mindfulness): Course guide for Expos 20 on mindfulness and the well-lived life

## Archives & Special Collections

- [Admissions: 1751-1899 - General Harvard Admissions Collection](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/hua/admissions): Guide to Harvard University Archives admissions records 1751-1899
- [Home - Betty Friedan](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/schlesinger_betty_friedan): Guide to Betty Friedan archival resources at Schlesinger Library
- [Harvard Project on the Soviet Social System](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/hpsss): Guide to Harvard Project on Soviet Social System Cold War oral histories
- [Home - Harvard Divinity School: The First Hundred Years](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/hds/1st-100): Guide to Harvard Divinity School institutional history archives

## Optional

- [Quick Facts - Harvard Buildings: Sever Hall](https://guides.library.harvard.edu/hua/severhall): Quick facts on Sever Hall history from Harvard University Archives
